issues.description: The successful write-to-upgradeable downgrade path constructs the new guard without performing the old write guard's release and wake-up side effects.
issues.rationale: The original implementation called drop(self) after compare_exchange succeeded. That drop path clears WRITER with fetch_and(!WRITER) and wakes queued waiters. This revision instead transfers the tracked resources and immediately returns RwMutexUpgradeableGuard after CAS changes the word to UPGRADEABLE_READER, without equivalent executable release or wake-up operations. The returned guard can therefore coexist with a stale WRITER bit and blocked waiters. Review 4050190316 requested changes for the missing drop, and later commits explicitly expand the release plus wake_all before returning.
